decision_rationale: All three designs passed deterministic schema and fake-provider integration and repaired the seeded defect with preserved tree and interface state. All three failed the real CLI single run and all three independent repeat runs. No design met the predeclared two-of-three CLI threshold, so selecting the numerically highest score would violate the minimum qualification rule.
common_failure_points: The public acceptance semantics were not decomposed into sufficiently explicit executable constraints for strict malformed-CSV rejection.
Generated public tests imported pytest even though the generated project hygiene rule permits only stdlib or project modules.
Artifact shape improved state transfer and repair locality, but did not prove that acceptance boundary facts were complete before generation.
